output.summary: An annual herb described as a North American species and widespread from Mexico through parts of Central and South America. Its finely divided leaves accompany many small, bright yellow flower heads. Its lemon-flavoured flowers are reported as edible garnishes, although the source flags this claim as needing a citation.
output.edibilityNote: The lemon-flavoured flowers are reported edible and used as garnish, but the source marks the claim as needing a citation.
